name: Knowledge Graph & AI Hub Heidelberg: The Context Layer for AI
description: talks on knowledge graphs and semantic layers as context for LLMs and agents
note: English listing; price not stated; Christmas market afterwards
details:
Evening meetup of the Knowledge Graph & AI Hub Heidelberg on how knowledge graphs and semantic layers give LLMs and AI agents verifiable context. Speakers: Denny Vrandečić (co-creator of Wikidata) with "Beyond Graphs: Knowledge Representation in the Age of LLMs", Andrea Splendiani (IQVIA) and Sebastian Schmidt (Digital Science).

Topics: grounding LLM answers in business knowledge, where a semantic layer sits between data sources and AI, building context-aware agents that run securely in production. Aimed at data and knowledge engineers, architects and AI practitioners; newcomers welcome. Afterwards the group moves on to the Heidelberg Christmas market. Price and language are not stated on the Meetup page (listing in English); RSVP on Meetup.
